summary: Every copy of a prop or character looks different: picks Model option choices (skin, outfit, paint), material colours from palettes, a height spread and an animation-speed spread per instance — seeded, so replays and peers agree.
setup: Add { "use": "model_variety" } to the prefab: every option the model declares varies; narrow it with "params": { "options": ["skin"], "choices": {"skin": ["light", "tan"]} }.
